key.label: adsb.lol API key
key.help: adsb.lol gives API keys to people who feed it: an ADS-B receiver at home sending what it hears to adsb.lol. The tracker works without a key today (adsb.fi is its main source, adsb.lol the fallback), but adsb.lol says keys will be required. Paste yours here: the orb keeps it beside the Wi-Fi password and sends it only to api.adsb.lol.

links.text: Feed adsb.lol to get a key
